description: Find the Google Data Commons place id (dcid) for a place name — country, state, county, city, region. Returns candidates with name and place type, e.g. "California" -> geoId/06, "India" -> country/IND. Use the dcid with datacommons_observation or datacommons_child_places. Narrow ambiguous names (Paris, Georgia) with place_type.

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

place_type.description: Restrict to one place type, e.g. Country, State, County, City, AdministrativeArea1, EurostatNUTS2

name: datacommons_find_place
title: Datacommons Find Place
